ns2:section.sectionText: MUST CHOOSE either 2 or 4 Credit Hours. Covers the design, implementation, assessment, marketing, and sustainment of gaming programs in public, school, and academic libraries, and other community or institutional settings. Surveys games for different demographic groups, and explores methods for integration of gaming with other library programming. Reviews the history of recreational gaming and the use of games in research, educational, and clinical contexts.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Information Sciences department.
